text_block_list.name: Television
text_block_list.text: 『The Twinkle Series! Stage where dreams of many Uma Musume reside! Who will carve their name atop that summit――!』

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: That stage was a distant place we all looked up to.

text_block_list.name: Laid-back Girl
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, amazing! Those Uma Musume are so fast!
Zooming by just like the wind!

text_block_list.name: Brusque Man
text_block_list.text:
Twinkle Series intensity hits different, as expected!
Hey, camera crew! Focus on the front-runners!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Out in the boonies with nothing to do,
TV screen showed a vivid, dazzling scene.
Everyone called it 『Another World』.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: But that ain't true, is it?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
That place sits under the exact same sky.
Just really far away right now.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: That's why, I'm gonna――!

text_block_list.name: Scout-seeking Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
My dream? Winning races, duh! Ask any
Uma Musume and you'll get the same answer.
Let's aim for the top together.

My dream is guiding an Uma Musume to G1 victories and
toppling legends from across the globe――
choice_data_list: I want to be that kind of Trainer

text_block_list.name: Scout-seeking Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
I see. Guess Trainers dream big too. Free to dream whatever.
Let's both give it our all! Later!

……Tried scouting her,
but she didn't take me seriously.
choice_data_list: ……Too big of a dream, I guess.

text_block_list.text:
Rookie Trainer spouting grand ambitions. Serious as I am,
probably sounds like pipe dreams to others.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: HaaaAAAAAA!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa……haa……

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
……Dammit. Still not enough……
Haa……was that last burst too weak? ……Hah!

How long had she been running?
Sweat already pouring down her face.

Wasn't dazzling speed,
nor overwhelming power matching elite ranks.

Felt like raw power running rampant,
a feverish, desperate charge.

Yet why couldn't I look away?
Like watching someone chase something with blazing hunger――

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haa-……! Alright. Still got gas in the tank.
This ain't all I've got――

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Incredible run……!
Excuse me, got a moment to talk?

text_block_list.name: Nervous-looking Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
S-so cool~……! Real running at its finest……
Um, could I speak with you too……

Turned toward the commotion.
Found a crowd of trainers and Uma Musume surrounding――

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
……Whew. Sorry, haven't run enough yet.
Raincheck for next time. See ya.

She pulled away from the crowd
and resumed running the course. Given the crowd,
must be an acclaimed runner.

Meanwhile――glanced back toward the previous runner.
She was already gone……

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa……!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ……Haha! Felt that burning stare……

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Shaaaaaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Thought it was you, Katsuragi Ace.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yo, C.B.—……! Looking bored, huh?
Haa……care for some company?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Inviting me to match paces? Was thinking
of a quick shower then strolling around though――

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Haa……Heh, but you're in, right?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ……Sounds fun, let's play!

Moved to a spot with clear view of both.
As crowd noise swelled, both shifted gears.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, pure intensity……!
Pulling away from her challenger!

text_block_list.name: Nervous-looking Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
Incredible……C.B.-san cuts right through the wind……
Katsuragi Ace-san can't keep up!

Looked like a real race showdown.
Yet only one held everyone's gaze――

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent run! Mr. C.B., please let me coach you!
With me, victory is guaranteed!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Appreciate the sentiment.
Sorry, gotta run.

text_block_list.name: Nervous-looking Uma Musume
text_block_list.text: Ah, C.B.-san!

Crowd chased after Mr. C.B. as she left.
Left behind――

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa……cough, haa……haa……
Standing alone, gasping for breath――

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Dammit……haa, haa……
Lost again, huh……crap……!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haa……Front-running escape against C.B.……
from that spot……haa, haa……haa……

Finishing at all after that pace was impressive.
Still, frustration showed.

Should I offer a simple 『Do your best next time』?
Not her trainer, but leaving her downcast felt wrong――

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Haa……Everyone's walking away……

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Underestimating me, huh. No, not even on their radar?
……Figures.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
――Haha! I'll show 'em, just watch……!
Laugh while you still can!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
One day……
every last one of you will be chasing my back……!
